incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 - inference-service 503 spike in us-west1. Pager routed to oncall. Initial surge started 2026-03-15T02:57:10Z. Alerting metrics: 503_rate=12.4% (1m), error_budget_burn high.
maya: I'm on shift. seeing the spike on the dashboard. taking first look.
maya: quick note — traffic seems concentrated on routes using model-rewrite-2 (canary).
ryan: I can help. I'll check model variant rollout and router logs.
conrad: I'm on my way in (30m). handing off incoming now — maya you remain primary until I confirm takeover.
maya: ok conrad that works. I will stay driving and assign comms. suzanne, can you take comms (customer updates + status page)?
suzanne: on it. I'll draft a short status: "Investigating increased 503 errors for generation endpoints in US-WEST. Mitigation in progress." Will post to status.redwood if we confirm customer impact >5%.
ops-runbook-bot: Runbook suggested: inference-503-spike. Steps: 1) Check router logs 2) Confirm model canary rollback 3) Scale replicas 4) Fallback to stable model variant. <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-503>
ryan: logs show steady 503s from svc-router-0 -> model-rewrite-2 nodes. grabbing kubectl now.
ryan: ```bash
kubectl -n inference logs svc-router-0 --since=10m | grep 503 -n
```
ryan: also seeing OOMs in model-rewrite-2 kubelet logs; might be a resource regression from recent quant changes.
maya: good catch. I'm going to pause the canary in the control plane and scale stable pool + route traffic away from canary.
maya: taking action: pausing rollout and increasing stable-replicas by +2.
incident-bot: action recorded by maya: pause_rollout model-rewrite-2 at 2026-03-15T03:00:12Z.
suzanne: posted initial status update to status page and customer slack channel, included approximate impact (12% of requests). :white_check_mark:
conrad: I'm 5m out. plan on taking driver once stable nodes catch up. maya pls confirm when safe to pass primary.
maya: rolling back canary now to stable. ETA ~4-5 min for routing to fully converge. After that I'll run a quick validation (sanity traffic) and then hand off.
ryan: rollback initiated, monitoring. CPU on stable nodes spiked but no errors.
maya: validation ok — generation route returning 200s on sanity traffic. I'll hand off: conrad you are primary now, I'm secondary/backup for next 30m. suzanne remains comms.
conrad: acknowledged — taking primary. thanks maya and ryan. I'll continue monitoring metrics for next 20m, will escalate to infra if we see another spike.
maya: leaving a couple of quick notes in the thread and runbook pointer for next oncall: check quantization commit id on the canary group, and watch KV cache miss rate.
suzanne: updated status page with mitigation summary and timeline. prepping incident postmortem template.
incident-bot: incident state: mitigated -> monitoring. Incident severity remains P1 until 1h of stable metrics.
conrad: creating follow-up TODOs and will ping infra if OOMs reappear. thanks team. :thumbsup:
